messages:
sam: FYI deploybot flagged a publish gap for staging image in eu at 2026-03-20T10:12Z. Manifest list missing after layers pushed. Logs show deploybot prefetch step skipped attaching manifestlist -> attestation missed. @deploybot what happened? :eyes:

deploybot: system: publish job 11234 failed to create manifestlist. Error: prefetch: layer-order-mismatch, returned 409 on /v2/my-repo/manifests/list. Retrying but skipped because dedupe flag true. Full log: ```ERR prefetch: manifest list write conflict: concurrent manifest exists``` 

anika: can you paste the deploybot logs around the push? suspect race with mirror/replicator.

deploybot: pasted snippet: ```[2026-03-20T10:11:58Z] push: layers ok
[2026-03-20T10:12:01Z] prefetch: check-manifestlist -> exists? no
[2026-03-20T10:12:03Z] prefetch: write -> 409 conflict -> dedupe skip``` 

kevin: sounds like prefetch checked "exists? no" then concurrent job created it -> 409. We should retry on 409 not skip. ops-oncall can we hold the staging canary?

ops-oncall: paused canary in EU, holding release. Rolling back routing to previous pinned digest until fix deployed.

jia: quick mitigation: patch deploybot to retry on 409 with exponential backoff and idempotent manifest overwrite where allowed. Opening PR and will coordinate hotfix canary.

marta: release notes draft: "staging image temporarily missing manifestlist in EU due to deploybot publish race; fixed in deploybot; no production impact." will add change window and link to follow-up PR.

qa-bot: running verification job `image-integrity-check` against previous pinned digest. All green :white_check_mark: 

sam: action items: jia open PR + link, kevin coordinate hotfix canary, ops-oncall keep hold until verification, marta update notes and loop in PM for customer comms if needed. Thanks everyone. :bow:
